spiritgiven.comments:
Want to commend team for keeping high spirits throughout the whole game. 
Body contact more than we would have liked from a few players - pushing off on players 
Fair-mindedness : felt that there was more than 1 instance where we felt that our perspective was not heard when discussing calls (that eventually went in opponents favor)

Rules: needed to improve in understanding of rules re body contact 
Fouls and body contact : first clarified going into the game and emphasized at half time about excessive body contact - but this was not addressed and fouls were repeatedly committed 
Positive attitude : had an incident of 1-2 individualscursing on field / towards our players 
Communication: unwillingness to listen to our perspective when discussing fouls, sidelines getting involved

Rules: did not know the rule for travel call (multiple stoppages)
Comm: appreciated that they called a spirit time out to clarify rules and adjusted calls appropriately

Commendable that good plays from both sides were celebrated, intensity and positivity kept high through the whole game
Fouls: despite letting players know about body contact, there did not seem there was an adjustment 
Communication: receptiveness on discussing calls can be improved - quick to contest without hearing other POV
A few negative comments on the sidelines during injury subs, disbelieving our validity of injury calls.

Had a discussion during the game regarding fouls and body contact which we appreciated 
However we felt that after the discussion,  the contact got worse - Pushing with the body or actively running and swinging arms out to stop path of cuts
A few instances of double team which was called during the points but we felt that players did not adjust throughout the game
Very positive attitude throughout the game. They celebrated and cheered for both sides despite being down.

Fouls and body contact: even after the spirit time out, our players still felt the pushing of arms, pushing players out of the way to get into the lane. Even after individual discussions, there was no adjustment 

Communication: during discussion of calls, our players felt that there was a defensive tone when they were trying to explain their point of view and it seemed that there was an unwillingness for open discussion
Had a great game with all calls settled on the field and good discussions between players, thank you!

spiritreceived.comments: when I talk to the spirit captains we agreed with the same standard but during game we feel like the players on the team have different understanding on body contact and we have a lot of calls that cannot be solved(they need to understand that it’s really hard to avoid body contact when the opponent play small balls)

We may had different recognition for travelling. But we are glad to held Sprit time out to communicate. 
we told them fouls such as fast count and wrapping for few times,but we are happy if they could try a bit more attentions to these fouls.

There was a lot of foul calls on us where your players called the foul on us for the contact initiated by your players. Your players need to chat with us to agree on the level of physicality after each point. 

Fair mindedness: Based on the SOTG rubric scoring, your team only took the stance that you were correct on calls, with your teammates only giving opinions where your result was favourable for your team.

We're thankful to the spirit captain for reminding the players to avoid contact. However, there were still several instances of body contact that were not avoided, even there was enough space to do so.

We commend your improved SOTG compared to previous game. Thank you for the adjustment in avoiding contact. We'd like to applaud your spirit captain for calling the spirit timeout to clarify some calls.
Great game! Thank you for adjusting your spirit:)
